This case is wrapped up for now, I guess. But obviously, this is far from a "closed case." The Marketing Development Department and that Lord Ravager, the real masterminds pulling the strings, are still sitting pretty, watching us run ourselves ragged.
Then again, I'm no Galaxy Ranger, so I don't need to go on some hunting to the bitter end. I'm just a normal gamer who gets paid to do a job. All that deep, complicated stuff isn't my problem.
Besides, we already caught Mia, so I can consider myself square with Skott. You're welcome, Lone Wolf. Let's just call it mutual respect between a good wolf and a bad wolf!
